description: This file exports types, functions, and modules related to MCP tools, session management, and runtime materialization in a project combining TypeScript modules for MCP (probably some form of multi-party computation or similar).

methods.name: createSessionMcpRuntime
methods.description: Creates a new MCP session runtime instance.

methods.name: disposeAllSessionMcpRuntimes
methods.description: Disposes of all active MCP session runtimes.

methods.name: disposeSessionMcpRuntime
methods.description: Disposes of a specific MCP session runtime.

methods.name: getOrCreateSessionMcpRuntime
methods.description: Retrieves an existing or creates a new MCP session runtime.

methods.name: createBundleMcpToolRuntime
methods.description: Creates a runtime for the bundle MCP tools.

methods.name: materializeBundleMcpToolsForRun
methods.description: Materializes MCP tools for a specific run.
